approach: Static recompilation of the PPU and SPU code to C with ps3recomp, HLE system libraries, Direct3D 12 RSX backend
help: Testing the motion minigames with a DualShock 3
notes: Needs your own copy of the game (a disc dump of BCAS20087 and its decrypted main program); the build happens on your PC. The title screen, menus, the Story into episode 2 and the first minigame run; the other minigames are untested.
